DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 受付の番号札はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a reception number ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この通知に四十二番とあるので、四十二番が呼ばれるのを待っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知の番号で待っていたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: This notice says number 42, so I was waiting for 42 to be called.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you were waiting using the number on the notice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: それは申込の管理番号です。今日の呼出番号とは別です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: That is the application reference number. It is different from today's calling number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 通知の番号で窓口の順番も決まると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の呼出番号との違いを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the number on the notice also determined my turn at the counter.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how it differs from today's calling number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 入口の発券機で、ご相談の項目を選んで番号札を取ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Select the subject of your consultation at the ticket machine by the entrance and take a number ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日の札を取り、通知の管理番号は担当へ見せる時に使うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号札が別に必要だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I take today's ticket and use the reference number on the notice when showing it to the person in charge.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that you need a separate number ticket. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのとおりです。通知もお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. Please bring the notice too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。通知をしまわず、正しい項目で札を取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知の番号を相談時に使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I won't put the notice away, and I'll get a ticket under the right category.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will use the notice number during the consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの発券機の「通知のご相談」をお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please select 'Consultation about a notice' on this ticket machine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 札を取りました。今日はこの番号で呼ばれたら進み、通知の四十二番は照合用に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正しい番号札を取って待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've got my ticket. I'll go forward when this number is called today, and show number 42 on the notice for matching the records.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take the correct number ticket and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。二つの番号を分けて確認できましたので、待合席でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Now that we've distinguished the two numbers, please wait in the waiting area.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日はご予約がおありですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have an appointment today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ウェブで申し込みました。この送信完了の画面があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: ウェブで申し込んだと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I applied online. I have this screen showing the submission was completed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you applied online. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約日時の確定を知らせる返信は届いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you received a reply confirming the appointment date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その返信は見ていません。送信できたら予約も終わりだと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 送信完了画面を見せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't checked that reply. I thought completing the submission meant the appointment was booked too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the submission-complete screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信完了と予約確定は分けて確認します。お名前と申込日をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: We check submission completion and appointment confirmation separately. Please give your name and application date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 名前はこちらです。昨日の夜に申し込みました。今、返信のメールも探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確定の返信が未確認だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here is my name. I applied last night. I'll also look for the reply email now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have not checked the confirmation reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらでも登録を確認しますので、画面をお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the registration here too, so please keep that screen with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。申込希望の日時と、実際に決まった日時が同じかも確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現在の予約状況を調べてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. I also want to check whether the requested date and time match the date and time actually confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to check your current appointment status. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れてから、本日の受付をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once we've confirmed it, we'll explain today's reception procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。予約済みと決めて診察を待たず、まず確定状況を教えてもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認後の案内で受診手続きする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I won't assume I'm booked and wait for the consultation; I'll first ask you to tell me the confirmation status.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Follow the guidance after confirmation to complete the consultation procedures. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。送信記録と登録を照合して、次の手続きをご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll match the submission record against the registration and explain the next step.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 本日は拾われた物のお届けですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you handing in something you found today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今日は物を持っていません。先週鍵を届けた時の控えをなくして、元の記録について聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 以前の届けの照会だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't have the item today. I lost the receipt from when I handed in some keys last week and want to ask about the original record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are inquiring about an earlier report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お届けいただいた日は覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember the day you handed them in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 先週の月曜の午後です。鍵三本に黄色い札が付いていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 控えをなくしたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Last Monday afternoon. There were three keys with a yellow tag attached.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost the receipt. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 新しい届けではなく、以前の受付を確認したいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: So this is not a new report; you want to check the earlier reception record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。控えの番号が分からなくても照会できるか、必要な情報を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 届けた日時と品物を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. Please tell me what information is needed and whether you can look it up without the receipt number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the date, time and item handed in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前や連絡先などを伺い、該当する受付を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll ask your name and contact details and check the corresponding reception record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 当時書いた名前と電話番号を伝えます。品物をもう一度届けた扱いにはしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 記録照会に必要な情報を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll give the name and telephone number I wrote then. Please don't treat it as handing in the item again.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask what information is needed to look up the record. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。以前の受付の照会として確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. We'll check it as an inquiry about the earlier reception record.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。日時、鍵の特徴、届けた時の名前で元の記録を探してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 元の届けを確認してもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll have you look for the original record using the date and time, the keys' features, and the name used when handing them in.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask them to check the original report. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。その情報をもとに確認し、控えに関する対応をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll check based on that information and explain what can be done about the receipt.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後の郵便についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about mail after moving, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。旧宅の今の住人から、私宛ての封筒が来たと連絡がありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旧宅への到着連絡を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The person now living at my old home contacted me to say an envelope addressed to me had arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain the arrival notification from your old home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 封筒は、まだ旧宅にある状態ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Is the envelope still at your old home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。未開封です。転居届の控えはこちらにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 封筒が未開封だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. It's unopened. Here is my copy of the mail forwarding change-of-address form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that the envelope is unopened. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 届の状況と、その封筒について担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the status of your form and ask the person in charge about that envelope.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。旧宅の人に開けて内容を読んでもらう前に、扱いを聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居届の状況を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Before asking the person at my old home to open it and read the contents, I'd like to ask how it should be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the status of your change-of-address form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: まず、宛名と住所など外から分かる情報を確認してもらってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: First, ask them to check information visible from the outside, such as the addressee and address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 封筒の外側だけ確認してもらいます。中身を開けてもらう依頼はしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧宅の人への依頼方法を担当に聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll have them check only the outside of the envelope. I won't ask them to open it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the person in charge what to ask the person at your old home to do. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受け渡しや郵便の扱いについては、担当が状況を伺ってご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The person in charge will ask about the situation and advise on handing it over and handling the mail.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。届の控えと、旧宅からの連絡を見せて、案内を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内が出るまで中身確認を頼まないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll show my copy of the form and the message from my old home, then wait for guidance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you won't ask for the contents to be checked until guidance is provided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。転居届の受付状況と、旧宅に届いた封筒の経過を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the reception status of the change-of-address form and what happened to the envelope delivered to your old home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 住所変更はこちらの口座ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is the account whose address you want to change, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。それと、別支店にもう一つ口座があります。今日の手続きで両方変わりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所変更の対象口座を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I also have another account at a different branch. Will today's procedure change both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Indicate the account for the address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 登録のつながりを確認しますので、もう一方の情報も見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check how the registrations are linked, so please show the other account's information too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。同じ銀行だから全部同時に変わると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 別支店にも口座があると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here it is. I thought everything would change together because it's the same bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you also have an account at another branch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実際の変更範囲を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the actual scope of the change before explaining it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。片方だけ古い住所が残るのを避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更範囲を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I want to avoid leaving the old address on just one account.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about the scope of the change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 二つの口座を特定し、必要な手続きを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll identify the two accounts and check the necessary procedures.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: どちらの口座も私の物です。こちらの支店と、もう一方の支店を別々にメモしました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二つの口座情報を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Both accounts are mine. I've noted this branch and the other branch separately.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Present the information for both accounts. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 完了した登録についても、それぞれ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can also check each completed registration separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、二口座の住所がどうなったか聞いてから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: それぞれの結果を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I'll ask what happened to the address on each account before I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the result for each one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つを対象に確認し、変更できる範囲と結果をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check both and explain the scope of what can be changed and the results.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食品の表示で気になる点がありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there something on the food label that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。原材料の欄にはありませんが、下の工場についての注意書きに卵とあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二つの欄の違いを質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Egg isn't in the ingredients section, but it's in the factory warning below.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the difference between the two sections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二つの欄を分けて確認しましょう。商品の表示を担当に見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the two sections separately. I'll show the product label to the person in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。卵を原材料として使っているという意味なのか、別の注意なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 気になる材料名を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I don't know whether it means egg is used as an ingredient or whether it's a different warning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the ingredient name that concerns you. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示の内容について、確認できる情報をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll provide the information we can confirm about the label's contents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私はこの表示だけで食べられるとは判断できないので、先に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原材料と注意表示を分けて確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can't judge from this label alone whether I can eat it, so I want to check first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the ingredients and warning label separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。必要であれば製造元への問い合わせ先もお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. We can also give the manufacturer's contact details if needed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。原材料欄だけ読んで購入を決めず、注意書きも見せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分には判断できないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I won't decide to buy just by reading the ingredients section; I'll show the warning too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you cannot judge it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この商品を、確認の担当者へお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please hand this product to the staff member checking it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 渡します。確認できるまで、かごに入れて会計するのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 購入前に担当への問い合わせを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will. Until it has been checked, I'll wait before putting it in my basket and paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for an inquiry to the person in charge before buying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。二つの表示の意味を確認して、ご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. We'll confirm the meaning of the two labels and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの洗い場をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using this washing area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 水筒が空になったので、水を入れたいです。蛇口があるから飲めると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 水筒補充を希望し蛇口があれば飲めると思ったと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: My water bottle is empty, so I want to fill it. I thought the water was drinkable because there was a tap.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to refill your bottle and assumed a tap meant the water was drinkable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 案内には、道具を洗う場所とあります。飲用の案内とは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The sign says this is for washing equipment. That's different from a drinking-water sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだ入れていません。水が透明でも、ここで飲めると判断しない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 補充前だと説明し透明さだけで飲用可否を決めないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't filled it yet. Even if the water is clear, I shouldn't assume I can drink it here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain you have not refilled it and confirm that clarity alone does not establish drinkability. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この洗い場での飲用はご案内していません。飲み水は別の場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: We do not designate this washing area for drinking water. Let's check another place for drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。水筒をすすぐ目的なら使えますか。飲む水を入れることとは分けて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: すすぎ用途と飲用補充を分け洗い場の利用可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. Can I use it to rinse my bottle? I want to ask about rinsing separately from filling it with water to drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Separate rinsing from refilling for drinking and ask whether the washing area may be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 利用できる用途を確認します。飲み水が必要なら、案内所でご相談いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the permitted uses. If you need drinking water, you can ask at the information office.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 洗うことも確認を待ちます。子どもには、この蛇口の水を飲まず、一緒に案内所へ行こうと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用途確認を待ち子どもへ飲まずに案内所へ行こうと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll wait for confirmation before washing it too. I'll tell my child not to drink from this tap and to go to the information office with me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Wait for confirmation of the uses and tell your child to go to the information office without drinking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 案内所は正面の建物です。飲み水の確保について担当へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The information office is the building straight ahead. Ask the person in charge about obtaining drinking water.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水筒は空のまま持って行きます。別の蛇口を見つけても、飲用の表示を確かめてから使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 空の水筒を持参し別の蛇口も飲用表示を確認して使うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the bottle empty. Even if I find another tap, I'll check that it's marked for drinking before using it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will take your empty bottle and check the drinking-water marking on other taps before use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。用途の表示と案内を確認し、こちらの水を飲むためには使わないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11224-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Check the signs and guidance about usage, and please do not use this water for drinking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: その荷物では切符を取り出しにくそうですね。いったん脇へ寄りましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: It looks hard to get your ticket out with that luggage. Shall we move aside for a moment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: お願いします。両手がふさがっていて、改札の前でかばんを開けられません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 両手がふさがる荷物の状況を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Please. Both my hands are full, and I can't open my bag in front of the ticket gate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that your luggage occupies both hands. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらなら通路をふさがず置けます。切符はどこに入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can put it here without blocking the passage. Where is your ticket?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 小さいかばんの内側です。大きい方を置いてから取り出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路外で切符を取り出すと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Inside the small bag. I'll put the large one down before taking it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decide to take out the ticket away from the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 切符が出たら、幅の広い通路へご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Once you've got the ticket, I'll show you to a wider passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 荷物を一つずつ先に通してもいいですか。切符を通す間に離れるのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を先に通す不安を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: May I pass my bags through one at a time first? I'm worried they'll be away from me while I put the ticket through.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss your worry about sending the luggage ahead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物だけ先へ送らず、こちらで通過方法をご案内します。持てる状態になってから進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't send the luggage ahead alone; we'll explain how to pass through here. Let's go once you're able to carry it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。切符は出せましたが、持ち手が片方外れているので直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 外れた持ち手を直す間待ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Okay. I've got the ticket, but one handle has come loose, so I'll fix it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask them to wait while you fix the loose handle. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 急がなくて大丈夫です。後ろの方には別の通路をご案内しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There's no rush. We're directing people behind you to another passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 直せました。荷物を手元にまとめて、そちらの通路から入ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 持ち直した荷物で案内された改札へ進む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: It's fixed. I'll keep the luggage together with me and go in through that passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Proceed to the indicated gate with your luggage held properly again. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらへどうぞ。荷物が引っかからないようゆっくりお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then this way, please. Go slowly so your luggage doesn't catch.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引っ越しの届出ですね。こちらの方は付き添いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're reporting a move, correct? Is this person accompanying you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。友人に来てもらいました。私が届けますが、説明を一緒に聞いてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人が届け出て友人も説明を聞きたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I asked my friend to come. I'll make the report myself, but may my friend listen to the explanation with me?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you will submit it yourself and ask for your friend to hear the explanation too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人へ説明しますので、難しい所を友人と確認していただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll explain to you, and you can check difficult parts with your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。転出の書類はこれです。「転入」の欄の意味から教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 転出資料を示し転入の意味を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Here are the moving-out documents. Please start by explaining what the 'moving in' section means.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the moving-out documents and ask what moving in means. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 前の市から、こちらの市へ住む場所を移した届出の欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: It's the section reporting that you moved your residence from your previous city to this city.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、ここには前の住所ではなく、今住んでいる住所を書くんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所を書く欄だと自分の言葉で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: So I write where I'm living now here, not my old address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in your own words that the section is for the new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。前の住所を書く欄は別にあります。順に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. There's a separate section for the old address. Let's check them in order.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人に全部書いてもらうのではなく、私が書いて分からない言葉を聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分で記入する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Rather than having my friend write everything, I'll write it myself and ask about words I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you plan to fill it in yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その形で大丈夫です。記入の前に住所が分かる資料を拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: That's fine. May I see a document showing your address before you write?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この契約書で確認してください。説明は短く区切ってもらえると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 住所資料を示して説明を区切ってもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please check this lease. It would help if you explained in short sections.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show an address document and ask for the explanation in sections. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一項目ずつ説明しますので、確認できたら次へ進みましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll explain one item at a time, and we'll move on once you've checked it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約票をお持ちですね。どのようなご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have your appointment slip. What would you like to discuss?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 変更の電話をしたのですが、自動案内でどれを選ぶか分からず切ってしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自動音声で窓口を選べなかったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I called to change it, but I didn't know which automated option to select and hung up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you couldn't select the department through the automated voice system. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 診療科と予約日を見せていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: May I see your department and appointment date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 内科の来週火曜日です。仕事の都合で別の日にしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 変更したい科と日を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Internal medicine next Tuesday. I'd like another day because of work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the department and date you want to change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この予約は内科の予約担当が確認します。代表番号からつなぐ場合の案内を書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: The internal medicine appointment staff will check this. I'll write the instructions for connecting through the main number.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 診療科の名前が出たら選べばいいですか。「初めての予約」は違いますよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 初回予約の項目ではないと確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Should I select it when the department name is announced? 'First appointment' is the wrong one, isn't it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that the first-appointment option is not the right one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回は予約済みの変更です。その項目が分からなければ、総合案内へ変更の用件を伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: This is a change to an existing appointment. If you can't identify that option, tell general information that you want to change it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 黙って待たず、「内科の予約変更をお願いします」と言ってつないでもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 総合案内へ変更の用件を伝える言い方を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Instead of waiting silently, I'll say, 'Please help me change my internal medicine appointment,' and ask to be connected.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the phrase for telling general information you want to change an appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。診察券の番号も用意しておくと確認が進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Having your patient card number ready will help the check proceed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号を控えました。今の予約はまだ変更されていないので、担当へ連絡してから予定を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 番号を用意し変更は未確定だと認識する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've noted the number. My current appointment hasn't been changed yet, so I'll contact the person in charge before deciding my plans.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare your number and recognize that the change is not yet confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その通りです。変更後の日時は担当から確認を受けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11225-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That's right. Have the person in charge confirm the new date and time.
